cases.testName: stable V2 kill switch preserves the read-only fail-closed adapter
cases.expected: With both stable V2 layers explicitly disabled, Goal does not register the host-native mutating lifecycle surface; read-only Goal inspection remains available and no command wrapping or mutation authority is introduced.

cases.testName: V2 status and contract stay readable while every lifecycle mutation fails closed
cases.expected: Status and contract reads remain available, but create/edit/pause/resume/clear/queue and other lifecycle mutations return the read-only boundary notice and leave the exact persisted Goal snapshot unchanged.

cases.testName: V2 presentation hooks remove stale control and never mutate persisted state, including Plan
cases.expected: Current-host context/request presentation may read persisted Goal state and defensively hide stale control, but cannot pause, resume, create, edit, clear, or otherwise mutate Goal state even when Plan is selected.

cases.testName: V2 read-only adapter fails closed when the session workspace cannot be resolved
cases.expected: Missing V2 session location.directory prevents Goal storage access instead of falling back to an unrelated process working directory.

cases.testName: V2 sequence and lifecycle controls stay read-only and never create or advance Goal state
cases.expected: Experimental V2 queue, next, create, edit, pause, resume, clear, and related mutation requests never create or advance stable Goal/sequence state while the host promotion gate is blocked.

cases.testName: direct lifecycle command mints host-message capability without persisting until the one-use tool consumes it
cases.expected: A direct command creates no Goal state by itself; only the exact host-message capability exposes mutating control, one tool call persists the Goal, replay fails, and post-tool continuation hides mutating control.

cases.testName: mismatched lifecycle arguments consume the capability before persistence and cannot be retried
cases.expected: Model-supplied lifecycle arguments that differ from the authenticated direct command consume and revoke the capability before any Goal persistence, and the authorized command cannot be retried with that capability.

cases.testName: ordinary prompt text and Plan contexts cannot arm or reuse lifecycle mutation
cases.expected: Ordinary command-like prompt text cannot mint control, Plan cannot expose mutating lifecycle control, and switching back to Build cannot reuse the revoked capability.

cases.testName: workspace changes fail closed after capability consumption and before Goal persistence
cases.expected: A capability bound to one session workspace is consumed and rejected if the session workspace changes before persistence, with no Goal written in either workspace.

cases.testName: authorized capability applies create pause resume edit and clear with one fresh host identity per mutation
cases.expected: Each lifecycle mutation requires a fresh host-authenticated capability and persists the expected create, pause, resume, edit revision, clear, and archive behavior.
